name: Isobar
author: Erin Carter
description: A satellite night-pass over a stormy sea: two or three spiral storm systems hang on the near-black chart, each a pinwheel of soft luminous log-spiral rain bands winding into a small dark calm eye, hue blending through the palette by radius. Each pinwheel revolves about its own eye at a stately pace while the systems drift bodily across the chart and breathe — arms brightening and eyes tightening as a storm peaks, relaxing as it decays.

params.label: Spin
params.effect: Angular speed of each pinwheel about its eye; 0 stops the rotation while drift and breathing keep the chart alive.

params.label: Drift
params.effect: Speed the storm systems travel bodily across the chart; 0 anchors them spinning in place.

params.label: Winding
params.effect: How tightly the rain bands coil into the eye, from open lazy arms to a dense gauzy vortex.

params.label: Eye size
params.effect: Diameter of each storm's dark calm eye in CSS pixels.
